### Step 1: Find the remainder when 172835 is divided by 136

We do the division:

$$
172835 \div 136
$$

$$

$$

- First, find how many times 136 fits into 172835.

We can use a calculator:

$$
172835 \div 136 = 1270 \text{ remainder } 65
$$
